name: Frederick William, Duke of Mecklenburg-Schwerin
contribution: The reigning duke of Mecklenburg in the Mecklenburg-Schwerin portion of the duchy of Mecklenburg from 1692 until 1713.
legacy: It brought the country to the brink of civil war and was settled only through the intervention of foreign powers

checks.lead: Frederick William (28 March 1675 – 31 July 1713) was the reigning duke of Mecklenburg in the Mecklenburg-Schwerin portion of the duchy of Mecklenburg from 1692 until 1713.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
